target_definition: Couple where both partners are approximately 25-30 years old and both work

population_anchor.note: Equal distribution within five-year age bands; ignores exact cohort migration and mortality. Rounded result should be presented as about 180 thousand persons.

partnership_model.note: Marriage and cohabitation anchors do not directly measure couples where both partners are in exactly the 25-30 band; the range explicitly absorbs this uncertainty.

employment_model.note: Lower benchmark is 0.714^2. Upper benchmark is Lithuania household share where all adults work: 64.9% all full-time + 5.8% at least one part-time and all others full-time.

result.publication_rounding: about 12-23 thousand; central scenario about 17 thousand

support_scale_context.warning: Do not publish these percentages as support coverage. The 515 legal young-family recipients are not the same population: scheme age reaches under 36 and includes other legal family configurations and territorial/eligibility filters.

sources: Lithuania 2021 Population and Housing Census age structure
Lithuania 2021 Census households and families / first-marriage cumulative rates
Eurostat tesem070 youth employment rate 20-29, Lithuania 2025 = 71.4%
Eurostat household working status 2025: Lithuania 64.9% all adults full-time + 5.8% at least one part-time, all others full-time
SADM 2025 annual report: 515 young families received first-home financial incentive
